_about: Audit C5 (12 Nov 2026, the owner's decision 30: ..\audit_2026-11-12\43_settings_rows_proposal.md): six settings that had no options row get one, Player tier, defaults unchanged. parent_on = the parent's option word under which the row is live (the aim assists act only with RETICLE aim). loot_min_value is a picker of fixed credit values (a slider steps evenly only; tools\ui_meta.py ALIASES gives the values). Apply with specpatch.py to part2_data.js and docs/UI_SPEC.json.

rows.label: Aim assist strength
rows.help: Reticle aim only: how strongly the reticle is pulled onto a hostile's lead cross.

rows.label: Slowdown on target
rows.help: Reticle aim only: how much the steering slows while the reticle is over a hostile's lead cross.

rows.label: Weapon group cue
rows.help: The weapon groups above the ring, filled when the target is in the centre and in reach.

rows.label: Hull damage pattern
rows.help: The pattern on the hull damage edge, so it never reads as a shield hit.

rows.label: Autopilot on servers
rows.help: On a server that says nothing about FLvibed: no autopilot, travel only (no combat), or everything. A server's own word always wins.

rows.label: Leave loot worth less than
rows.help: The autopilot leaves loot worth less than this, at the item's base price.
